payload.claim: test_each_claim_is_asked_of_its_own_session_that_is_never_shown_a_witness only checks that a criterion's claim text appears somewhere in its probe prompt (`"the guard rejects a negative amount" in probe_prompts[0]`), never that it lands in the claim slot rather than the diff slot. Swapping `spec=claim,` / `diff=diff,` at review.py:362-363 to `spec=diff,` / `diff=claim,` would show each session the unified diff under the prompt's '## The claim' heading and the claim text under '## The diff' heading — breaking the acceptance criterion that each session is given its own entry's claim — yet the claim string would still be present in the assembled prompt (just under the wrong heading), so every assertion in that test, and in test_review.py's criterion-probe tests (which never inspect the system prompt at all), would stay green.
